title: DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Model for Fall Detection
description: Detect a person falling via a wrist-worn device
long_description: Advance the development of intelligent wearable devices with the DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Model for Fall Detection. This deployment-ready Edge AI model accurately identifies fall events in real time from wrist-worn sensors, helping enable timely assistance, enhanced user safety, and greater peace of mind.
